title: Wretchedly
summary: WRETCHEDLY, adverb 1. Most miserably; very poorly. The prisoners were wretchedly lodged. 2. Unhappily; as two wars wretchedly entered upon. 3. Meanly; despicable; as a discourse wretchedly delivered.
